big_case.notes: Resolving whether federal common law or state contract law governs nonsignatory equitable estoppel under the New York Convention would answer the choice-of-law question expressly reserved in GE Energy Power Conversion France SAS, Corp. v. Outokumpu Stainless USA, LLC (2020) and settle a recurring circuit conflict affecting international arbitration and surplus-lines property insurance litigation. However, the dispute remains a technical commercial-arbitration question presented here in a derivative, unpublished companion vehicle rather than a matter of broad public or constitutional salience.
